scenes.title: Veri-Gate
scenes.takeaway: A clear record of each gate movement.
scenes.narration: Meet Veri Gate. Record which vehicle is moving, who is driving, and when it passes through the gate. Here is the current review workflow.

scenes.title: Start with the vehicle.
scenes.narration: Start by scanning the vehicle barcode. The field opens scan ready, with keyboard input suppressed. When typing is needed, tap the field. The tap marks that entry as manual.

scenes.title: Then the driver.
scenes.takeaway: Scan or enter the employee number.
scenes.narration: Next, scan the driver employee number. Confirm the driver before choosing the movement direction.

scenes.title: Flexible employee IDs.
scenes.takeaway: Letters are supported alongside numeric IDs.
scenes.narration: Employee numbers can include letters, as this demonstration record shows. Numeric forms such as one zero zero three and E M P dash one zero zero three still resolve to E one zero zero three.

scenes.title: Choose IN or OUT.
scenes.takeaway: Direction comes after vehicle and driver.
scenes.narration: Choose whether the vehicle is entering or leaving. Then continue to the review screen.

scenes.title: Review, then submit.
scenes.takeaway: Vehicle, driver, direction, gate and time.
scenes.narration: Choose the direction, then review the movement before submitting. The scanner returns to the start after recording it.

scenes.title: A new scanned vehicle.
scenes.takeaway: Continues without a barcode warning or review flag.
scenes.narration: An unknown scanned barcode continues without a barcode warning. Its vehicle record is created when the movement is submitted, without a Check barcode flag. Normal driver checks still apply.

scenes.title: Complete the barcode.
scenes.takeaway: G00 is incomplete. Enter all four digits.
scenes.narration: When typing is needed, tap the barcode field. That tap enables typing and records manual entry. A partial barcode such as G zero zero is refused. Enter all four digits.

scenes.title: Check a typed barcode.
scenes.takeaway: A complete unknown barcode can continue.
scenes.narration: A complete typed barcode that is not in inventory warns: Check this barcode. Continue if it is right. The movement can proceed, and the vehicle is marked Check barcode for supervisor review.

scenes.title: A supervisor can review.
scenes.takeaway: Typed unknown vehicles show Check barcode.
scenes.narration: In the console, the vehicle created from the typed unknown barcode is marked Check barcode, making it visible for supervisor review.

scenes.title: Controlled exceptions.
scenes.takeaway: Fleet Lead or above can approve.
scenes.narration: For a driver who needs temporary authorization, approval requires a Fleet Lead or higher role. Here, an approver with the Scanner role is refused.

scenes.title: Select the duration.
scenes.narration: Choose nine hours, twelve hours, today, forty eight hours, or three days. Nine hours is the default selection.

scenes.title: The Supervisor Console.
scenes.narration: The desktop console brings vehicle inventory and operational records together for supervisors.

scenes.title: Start with a VIN.
scenes.takeaway: A blank barcode is assigned automatically.
scenes.narration: To add a vehicle, enter its V I N. Other details can be completed later. Leave the barcode blank to assign the next free G barcode automatically.

scenes.title: Saved to inventory.
scenes.takeaway: The VIN and assigned barcode appear together.
scenes.narration: The saved vehicle now appears in inventory with its automatically assigned barcode. Select its V I N to open the record.

scenes.title: Open the right record.
scenes.takeaway: Select a User ID or name.
scenes.narration: User records open from their User I D or name, keeping the record directly accessible from the list.

scenes.title: Devices and locations.
scenes.takeaway: Select a Device ID to open its record.
scenes.narration: Select a Device I D to open that device. Supervisors can review the location and device details associated with gate operations.

scenes.title: Find the movement.
scenes.narration: Search movement history by driver, vehicle, location, or date. The information captured at the gate remains available to review.

scenes.title: Veri-Gate
scenes.narration: This Android review build stores records on the device. Shared cloud data and automatic synchronization are still being developed. Veri Gate brings a focused workflow to the gate and a clearer record afterward.
